furniture.configuration.enableReflection: Mirrors render live reflections. Disable for better performance.
furniture.configuration.renderDistance.t: Distance in blocks within which mirrors render reflections.
furniture.configuration.maxMirrors.toolt: How many mirror surfaces can reflect at the same time.
furniture.configuration.enableBlur.toolt: Reflections are slightly blurred like old glass.
How far in blocks a mirror reflects the world.
furniture.configuration.enableCreeperPra: Right-clicking a mirror with paper named "Spieglein, Spieglein" or "Mirror, Mirror" summons a lit creeper behind you.
furniture.configuration.merchantRange.to: Radius in blocks in which the cash register looks for a villager to trade with.
furniture.configuration.autoCloseSeconds: Seconds until an open cash register closes on its own.
furniture.configuration.enableShaking.to: Boats in a jar can be shaken by right-clicking them.
furniture.configuration.enableBreaking.t: Shaking a boat in a jar too hard breaks the mast.
furniture.configuration.breakThreshold.t: Roughly how many quick shakes in a row break the mast.
furniture.configuration.animationSpeed.t: Speed of the rocking animation in percent. 0 stops it.
furniture.configuration.enableStorm.tool: Right-clicking a boat in a jar with a water bottle starts a tiny storm inside.
furniture.configuration.enableThunderRoc: Boats in a jar rock harder during thunderstorms.
furniture.configuration.enableBounce.too: Entities bounce off pouffes like a small trampoline.
furniture.configuration.bounceStrength.t: Bounce strength in percent of the landing speed.
furniture.configuration.fallDamage.toolt: Fall damage taken on a pouffe in percent.
furniture.configuration.enableEerieEleve: Playing disc 11 makes the surroundings flicker eerily.
The horn pulses to the music while a disc is playing.
furniture.configuration.enableCatsWatchF: Nearby cats sit in front of fish tanks and stare at the fish.
furniture.configuration.maxDurability.to: How much damage a pells can take before it breaks.
furniture.configuration.bagDropChance.to: Chance in percent that a full bin drops a trash bag.
furniture.configuration.enableStink.tool: Nearly full bins give off green stink clouds.
furniture.configuration.enableTrashBagCo: Whether opening a trash bag puts it on cooldown.
furniture.configuration.trashBagCooldown: Seconds before a player can open the next trash bag.
furniture.configuration.flyFrequency.too: One in this many frames spawns a fly at a full bin. Higher means fewer flies.
furniture.configuration.flyLifetime.tool: Minimum lifetime of a fly in ticks.
How many blocks away from a steam vent a heat source is searched.
furniture.configuration.maxPipeLength.to: How many pipe blocks a single steam network can have.
furniture.configuration.enablePipePartic: Pressurized pipes leak, drip and burst steam.
furniture.configuration.enableVentPartic: Steam vents emit steam and chimney smoke.
furniture.configuration.enableShootingSt: Shooting stars appear while looking through a telescope at night.
furniture.configuration.shootingStarRari: One in this many ticks spawns a shooting star. Higher is rarer.
furniture.configuration.minMagnification: Weakest zoom level when scrolling out.
furniture.configuration.maxMagnification: Strongest zoom level when scrolling in.
furniture.configuration.maxDistance.tool: How far in blocks you can move away from a telescope before you stop looking through it.
furniture.configuration.enableBobbing.to: Items on displays gently float up and down.
furniture.configuration.enableSoot.toolt: Chimneys slowly get sooty over time.
furniture.configuration.sootRarity.toolt: One in this many ticks a chimney gets sooty. Higher is slower.
furniture.configuration.enableChime.tool: Grandfather clocks ring a bell at dawn.
furniture.configuration.enableMidnightSt: Grandfather clocks strike twelve times at midnight.
furniture.configuration.enableStartleMob: The midnight strike makes nearby mobs flinch.
furniture.configuration.enableTicking.to: Clocks and grandfather clocks tick audibly.
furniture.configuration.tickingVolume.to: Volume of the ticking in percent.
furniture.configuration.Info Tooltips.to: Info tooltips that appear when looking at a block. Only affects your own screen.
furniture.configuration.showFishTankInfo: Shows an info tooltip when looking at a fish tank.
furniture.configuration.showWardrobeInfo: Shows an info tooltip when looking at a wardrobe.
furniture.configuration.showBinInfo.tool: Shows an info tooltip when looking at a bin.
furniture.configuration.showTelescopeInf: Shows an info tooltip when looking at a telescope.
furniture.configuration.showLampInfo.too: Shows an info tooltip when looking at a lamp.
furniture.configuration.showCashRegister: Shows an info tooltip when looking at a cash register.
furniture.configuration.showSteamVentInf: Shows an info tooltip when looking at a steam vent.
furniture.configuration.showBoatInAJarIn: Shows an info tooltip when looking at a boat in a jar.
furniture.configuration.showPellsInfo.to: Shows an info tooltip when looking at a damaged pells.
furniture.configuration.showPellsStats.t: Shows the health and armor of a pells while you hold a weapon.
furniture.configuration.enableFishTankAm: Fish tanks make quiet water sounds.
furniture.configuration.cofferVolume.too: Volume of the coffer open and close sounds in percent.
